# Headlight

> Headlight is a physician-led mental health platform offering online therapy, specialized treatments like esketamine (Spravato®), and evidence-based care for conditions including anxiety, depression, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and PTSD.

Headlight combines telehealth therapy with innovative treatments and maintains in-person clinic locations across the US. The platform accepts major insurance providers including Aetna, Cigna, and Blue Cross, making mental health care more accessible.

## Key Topics

- Mental health therapy
- Esketamine treatment
- Treatment-resistant depression
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- ADHD treatment
- Anxiety disorders
- Depression
- PTSD and trauma
- Couples therapy
- Insurance coverage
- Licensed therapists
- Medication management
- Telehealth services
- Evidence-based treatment

## Core Services

- [Headlight - Therapy & Mental Health Services](https://headlight.health): Headlight homepage: online therapy, esketamine treatment, mental health services
- [All Treatments - Headlight](https://headlight.health/treatments): Treatment options: ACT, CBT, DBT, EMDR and other therapeutic approaches
- [Focus Areas - Headlight](https://headlight.health/focus-areas): Provider specialties: ADHD, anxiety, bipolar disorder, acute stress disorder
- [Esketamine (Spravato®) Nasal Treatment - Headlight](https://headlight.health/esketamine-treatment): Esketamine/Spravato nasal spray for treatment-resistant depression

## Therapy Modalities

- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) - Headlight](https://headlight.health/cognitive-behavioral-therapy-cbt): CBT therapy guide: shifting negative thoughts and behaviors for anxiety/depression
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) - Headlight](https://headlight.health/dialectical-behavior-therapy-dbt): DBT therapy guide: emotion regulation, mindfulness, trauma and PTSD treatment
- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) - Headlight](https://headlight.health/acceptance-and-commitment-therapy-act): ACT therapy guide: psychological flexibility and mindfulness-based treatment
- [Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) - Headlight](https://headlight.health/eye-movement-desensitization-and-reprocessing-emdr): EMDR therapy: trauma processing, PTSD recovery, emotional healing
- [Couples Therapy - Headlight](https://headlight.health/couples-therapy): Couples therapy: relationship counseling, communication, conflict resolution

## Mental Health Conditions

- [Anxiety - Headlight](https://headlight.health/anxiety): Anxiety disorder guide: GAD information, symptoms, treatment, insurance coverage
- [Depression Treatments - Headlight](https://headlight.health/depression): Depression guide: MDD, persistent depressive disorder, symptoms, treatment
- [Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) - Headlight](https://headlight.health/adhd): ADHD guide: symptoms, diagnosis, adult/childhood ADHD, insurance coverage
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment - Headlight](https://headlight.health/bipolar-disorder): Bipolar disorder guide: types, symptoms, mood disorder care, insurance
- [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) Treatment - Headlight](https://headlight.health/ptsd): PTSD guide: trauma therapy, symptoms, trauma-informed care, treatment options
- [Stress Treatment - Headlight](https://headlight.health/stress-treatments): Stress treatment: acute stress disorder, chronic stress management, insurance
